newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian leu 4,363 to dollar for Jan 14 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romanian leu 4,363 to dollar for Jan 14 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's National Bank (BNR) announced the leu's reference rate at 4,363 to the dollar for January 14.
This reference rate was set on Friday as a weighted average based on daily reports of foreign exchange operators. It is a guidance rate used for statistical accounting purposes.
The leu's reference rate set on Thursday for January 13 is 4,370 to the dollar. It was 4,268 for January 10-12. -- Bucharest Newsroom 40-1 3120264
